name: Pace / Prego - Dixon CA
type: Manufacturing - tomato processing for sauces (Prego / Pace), Campbell Soup Supply Co.

fieldNotes.identity: Roster address (1606 Pedrick Road) is incorrect. The Campbell's Dixon facility is the Campbell Soup Supply Co. tomato-processing plant at 8380 Pedrick Road, Dixon CA 95620 - it processes ~660,000 tons of tomatoes/year into Prego spaghetti sauce and Pace picante sauce base. OSM places 8380 Pedrick Rd at 38.4743,-121.8038. Satellite confirms a large multi-building agricultural processing campus surrounded by farmland. Locked center 38.4745,-121.8025.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off Pedrick Road has a fenced driveway with a sliding/rolling chain-link gate (visible parked open in 2024 Street View) and white jersey-barrier lane chicane creating a checkpoint pinch-point. truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No proper staffed guard booth visible at the gate - only a small portable structure (appears to be a portable toilet). guardShack=false; medium confidence (a booth could be obscured).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard booth -> remote/kiosk/call-box check-in implied. remoteGs=true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved interior holding/queue areas inside the gate before the docks and drop yard.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive on-site drop yard with 50+ parked trailers across the central/southern yard. dropArea 50+, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks distributed across warehouses in the trailer-yard area; tomato intake is largely bulk (gondola/tanker), not dock-door. Estimated 10-20 dock doors total -> 10-25 band; low confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Bulk tomato receiving at the N processing plant is physically separate from the warehouse/drop-yard shipping operations to the south.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 8+ distinct buildings: processing plant, warehouses, outbuildings, plus settling ponds.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Surrounded by open farmland east of Dixon - clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but adjacent to a developed industrial strip and not deeply isolated; cellular coverage likely adequate. Marked false, low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail corridor runs in the broader area but no spur enters the property; tomato intake is by truck. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.scale: Truck scales are likely present at an agricultural intake plant of this scale but not clearly resolved in imagery - left false, flagged uncertain.
